name: The Decrepit Ferry
summary: At the Decrepit Ferry, rot hides swarm the dock east of The Sepulcher. High Executor Hadrec sends Forsaken champions to learn why the Scourge has gathered along Lordamere Lake's shore.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Lake
sections.body: High Executor Hadrec turns east after the Scourge presence in the Dead Fields is suppressed. The Decrepit Ferry lies among Silverpine Forest's eastern waterways, where mainland Lordaeron once connected to the island estates of Lordamere Lake. Now undead gather around its rotted piers. Hadrec sends scouts to find out what draws the Lich King's servants there.

sections.title: A Grim Cargo
sections.body: At the ferry, rot hides patrol the marshy banks. A waterlogged skiff rests beside the dock, carrying carefully wrapped, preserved corpses. Across the mist of Lordamere Lake, docks on Fenris Isle reveal where the bodies are headed: toward the island keep.

faq.q: Who sends you to the Decrepit Ferry?
aliases: who gives the decrepit ferry quest
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec, the Forsaken military commander at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, sends you after you help clear the Dead Fields.

faq.q: Where is the Decrepit Ferry located?
faq.answer: The Decrepit Ferry lies east of The Sepulcher, along Lordamere Lake's western bank where inland creeks meet open water.

faq.q: What creatures occupy the Decrepit Ferry?
aliases: what enemies are at the ferry
faq.answer: Scourge undead occupy the area, mainly rot hide gnolls and reanimated skeletons that patrol the shore and docks.

faq.q: What do you discover at the ferry?
faq.answer: You find a corpse-laden boat pulled halfway out of the water, with wrapped bodies ready to be shipped across the lake toward Fenris Isle.

faq.q: Why does the Scourge care about the ferry?
aliases: why are scourge at decrepit ferry
faq.answer: The ferry gives the Scourge a crossing over Lordamere Lake, carrying fresh corpses directly to its stronghold on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: What quest follows The Decrepit Ferry?
faq.answer: Inspecting the corpse-laden boat leads to Rot Hide Clues, where you investigate the gnoll operations and their link to Fenris Isle.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you face a direct threat to Tirisfal's borders and the Undercity whenever the Scourge gains a foothold in Silverpine.
As Horde, you help protect supply lines through Silverpine by securing the perimeter around Lordamere Lake from northern Scourge incursions.
